description: Four detectors are defined but never registered in all() — ~180 lines of unreachable code that mislead readers and risk accidental re-registration: detect_rust_fn (line 182, removed for 100% FP), detect_unused_import (line 307, 'Gleam tree-sitter module parsing is broken'), detect_redundant_pipeline (line 373, '|> is idiomatic, 100% FP'), detect_complex_pipeline (line 688, unregistered near-duplicate of detect_pipeline_steps_overload with identical message text). Delete them; the disabling rationale is already captured in comments next to the all() entries — move any still-relevant rationale into those comments. Deleting before the traversal refactor shrinks the rewrite surface.
title: Delete dead detectors from gleam_rules.ml
